newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland wants road tax to be part of excise tax.
newsitem.headline: Poland wants road tax to be part of excise tax.

text.p: The Polish government on Tuesday supported a parliamentary draft bill which abandons the country's road tax in its current form and makes it 30 percent of the fuel excise tax, the transport minister said.
"The government proposes that from January 1, 1998, the road tax would amount to 30 percent of the fuel excise tax," Boguslaw Liberadzki said.
Liberadzki said owners of cars heavier than 3.5 tonnes would continue to pay the tax according to current rules.
He said the new form of the road tax should not directly lead to increasing fuel prices, but fuel may become more expensive due to a planned 15 percent increase in the exise tax in 1998.
"One can expect prices to rise by four groszes per litre (as a result of the exise tax increase)," he said.
